text:
ADMINISTERING A SUBSTANCE WITH INTENT

STEP TWO
Starting point and category range
Having determined the category, the court should use the corresponding starting points to reach a
sentence within the category range below. The starting point applies to all offenders irrespective of plea
or previous convictions. Having determined the starting point, step two allows further adjustment for
aggravating or mitigating features, set out below.
A case of particular gravity, reflected by multiple features of culpability or harm in step one, could merit
upward adjustment from the starting point before further adjustment for aggravating or mitigating
features, set out below.
Category 1 Starting point

6 years’ custody
Category range

4 – 9 years’ custody
Category 2 Starting point

4 years’ custody
Category range
